name: Quantum Wavefunction
desc: A 2D Schrodinger wavefunction evolving in real time, its probability density blooming into interference fringes and self-focusing lumps as the quantum phase spins through a full colour wheel, rendered as phase-hued density, thermal heat, blue-white wave fringes, spectral glow, or an x-ray greyscale.

well.doc: confining potential (0 = free box, 1 = tight trap)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
